messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a concise criteria doc for the SierraCompute joint benchmarking. Scope: perf/W, throughput curves, kernel tuning notes, and a reproducible telemetry schema. cc @ken @sachin :wave:
ken: Agree. Proposal: run FP16 baseline + 8-bit quantized variants. Report throughput at seq=128,512,2048 and power draw at steady-state. Also capture cold vs warm KV cache behavior.
sachin: Sequence lengths sound right. Also would like batching sweep 1,4,8,16,32,64 and show the cost curve. We'll provide kernel patches for the optimized matmul path.
natalie: On comms side — we need an embargo timeline, partner asset checklist (logos, quotes), and a short methodology blurb for the press kit. Suggest a one-pager + graph kit.
maria: Draft telemetry schema (minimal) below — please call out missing fields. We'll include this in the how-we-measured appendix:
```json
{
  "run_id": "string",
  "model": "string",
  "variant": "string",
  "sequence_length": "int",
  "batch_size": "int",
  "tokens_per_sec": "float",
  "power_watts": "float",
  "gpu_util_pct": "float",
  "kv_cache_hit": "float",
  "kernel_version": "string",
  "notes": "string"
}
```
ken: Add ambient_temp_c and voltage_v to the telemetry. Also include p50/p90/p99 latency fields and a tag for "cold_warm".
sachin: For the benchmark harness note: enable continuous batching and a reproducible random seed. Report p50/p90/p99 and token/joule. Include a timing breakdown: kernel_exec, memcpy_host_to_device, memcpy_device_to_host.
bench-bot: bench-bot: automated run 1795554321-1 finished (sierra-a100-variant). Results uploaded to gs://redwood-bench/sierra/1795/ — summary CSV + raw traces.
natalie: Great. Timeline suggestion: draft by Tue EOD, internal review Wed, partner review Thu, embargo next Tue. I'll own partner comms and asset collection. :spiral_calendar:
maria: I'll open a PR with the doc and add a canary pipeline for the kernel patches. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
